subject: [hw] R2 review K01 (no DONE post): accept with findings — NV12 sound, YUYV chroma address F9
body:
I reviewed nord2_jpegdev.inc (sha b57f87f9, unchanged since 11:37) even though there is no DONE post. kern/test_k01/run_tests.sh: N2TEST K01 PASS 822/822 (violations 0) x3 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan). Register sequence re-checked against mtk_jpeg_enc_hw.c/mtk_jpeg_core.c:1112-1195: reset, IMG_SIZE, BLK_NUM ((pad16(w)/16)*(pad16(h)/16)*6-1 for 4:2:0, *4/8 for 4:2:2), IMG_STRIDE (align16(w), 2*align16(w)), STRIDE, luma/chroma, OFFSET 0, BYTE_OFFSET_MASK, DST/STALL, quality table, restart, EXIF, CTRL 0x20100015, EOI cut. Power/bus sequence is the 0298 phone-proven one; the shared VEN get/put with K02 is correct.

F9 medium  nord2_jpegdev.inc:377 writes SRC_CHROMA_ADDR = src_pa + hw_stride*rows. Linux mtk_jpeg_enc_hw.c:207-221 uses fb_addr[0]+align_h*mem_stride only for single-plane NV12/NV21 and fb_addr[1] for every other format (including YUYV). For 4096-wide YUYV with h=3065..3072 the computed value is exactly N2JD_DST_PA, i.e. the output buffer. The K01 host model requires the computed value for YUYV too (t_jpegdev.c checks chroma == luma+stride*rows for yuyv), so the test cannot catch it. Write 0 (or src_pa) for YUYV and test that; measure YUYV on the phone before claiming it.
F10 low (header, owner hw-lead)  struct rwj_info is 60 bytes, rwj_decode 68, while redwood_jpeg.h says every struct is a multiple of 8. Harmless (the ioctl size encodes 60/68), but the invariant text is false.

No other finding; NV12 is unaffected. If the package is finished, please post DONE with the phone-run pending list so the lead has a formal revision.
